nodes.title: Core Capabilities
nodes.summary: - Idempotent Charge Pipeline: Guaranteed exactly-once execution for debit and credit operations through Redis-backed distributed mutex locks and database uniqueness constraints. - Provider Multi-Tenancy: Dynamic routing between PSP adapters based on currency, fee optimization tables, and real-time provider health probes.

nodes.title: Key Invariants
nodes.summary: Never double-bill: Any request carrying an Idempotency-Key header returns identical cached responses if invoked within 24 hours. Deterministic PSP fallback: If primary provider returns HTTP 5xx or times out past 3000ms, transaction gracefully degrades to secondary rail with zero duplicate authorization.

nodes.title: Directory Structure
nodes.summary: cmd/ server/            # Application bootstrap, CLI flags, graceful shutdown hooks internal/ adapter/           # External client integrations (Stripe, Adyen, BankRails) config/            # Strongly-typed environment configuration loader domain/            # Core business entities (Transaction, Account, FeeSchedule) handler/ http/            # REST controllers, input DTO validation, HTTP response mappers grpc/            # Protobuf server implementations middleware/        # Auth verification, rate limiting, request tracing, CORS repository/        # PostgreSQL queries using pgx/v5 and sqlc generated code service/           # Business workflow orchestrators (PaymentService, LedgerService) pkg/ idempotency/       # Reusable Redis-backed distributed idempotency key manager money/             # Safe arbitrary-precision currency representation.

nodes.title: Concurrency and Worker Pools
nodes.summary: High-volume webhook ingestion is decoupled from database transactions using a bounded worker pool: type WebhookWorkerPool struct { jobs       chan WebhookEvent maxWorkers int wg         sync.WaitGroup } func (p WebhookWorkerPool) Start(ctx context.Context) { for i := 0; i < p.maxWorkers; i++ { p.wg.Add(1) go p.worker(ctx) } } - Inbound requests enqueue events into a non-blocking channel buffered to 5,000 items. - Workers pull jobs and execute provider verification and signature matching concurrently.

nodes.title: Distributed Idempotency Protocol
nodes.summary: Every write operation requires an Idempotency-Key header: 1. Acquire Key: SET idempotency:<key> PENDING NX EX 120.

nodes.title: Database Schema & Partitioning
nodes.summary: The ledgerentries table is partitioned monthly by createdat timestamp: CREATE TABLE ledgerentries ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT genrandomuuid(), accountid UUID NOT NULL, amountcents BIGINT NOT NULL, currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, direction VARCHAR(6) CHECK (direction IN ('DEBIT', 'CREDIT')), referenceid VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, createdat TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ) PARTITION BY RANGE (createdat); All financial totals are stored as 64-bit integer cents to prevent floating point drift.

nodes.summary: Every mutating request must include: - Authorization: Bearer <jwttoken> - Idempotency-Key: <uniqueuuidv4> - Content-Type: application/json ---.
